description: This file provides utility functions for string formatting, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case for use across a front-end application. It includes functions to normalize strings, handle special characters like apostrophes, underscores, hyphens, and provide consistent string representations for UI components.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling delimiters like spaces, underscores, and hyphens, collapsing multiple spaces, and preserving the original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, handling delimiters, accented characters, and apostrophes, with normalization to title case including proper capitalization after apostrophes.
